title: XSD text, names and binary value families
api_or_output: Internal XSD datatype family implementation; no partial public validator

acceptance.description: Implement XSD1.0 string/normalizedString/token/language/name/ID/IDREF/ENTITY atomic families, boolean, anyURI, QName/NOTATION, hexBinary/base64Binary and anySimpleType behavior through verified core contracts. Preserve namespace-qualified value identity, exact binary octets and scalar lengths; schema notation/retained-DTD existence validation remains with XSD validation owner. Built-in NMTOKENS/IDREFS/ENTITIES list parsing and nonempty enforcement are owned by the composing M8-datatypes task; this family supplies the bounded NMTOKEN/IDREF/ENTITY atomic parsers.

Test XML whitespace/name grammar, multilingual/supplementary scalars, namespace/default-prefix contexts, boolean/URI semantics, strict hex/base64 syntax including padding, equality/hash/order and invalid inputs. Charge scans/comparisons/growth and test exact budgets/cancellation.

Compile against verified model/core only; record applicable owned-output and borrowed primitive allocation/performance evidence, focused earlier checks and exact internal interfaces. Leave final complete library dispatch/composition to M8-datatypes.

handoff.summary: Planned bounded child of M8-datatypes; original complete XSD1.0 acceptance and gate reachability preserved. Core contract review keeps boolean here; built-in list parsing/nonempty/lexical/list-ownership tests explicitly transferred to composition, with no lost capability or case.
